notes.title: [Erase News Letter vol.14] Status Update and Release of Development Screenshots
notes.content: [p]Hello Players, [/p][p]In this letter, we would like to inform you of our development progress and our upcoming event participation.  [/p][p]While it can be difficult to visually convey development progress, and some information cannot yet be disclosed, development is proceeding on a daily basis! [/p][p][/p][h3]- Persistent display of card effect targets during battle[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658881/0b0cdf7065c567233992f3522761b2429789aa32.gif"][/img][/p][p]To address the issue that "it is difficult to tell what a card is targeting," we have made the target indicators persistently visible. [/p][p]When retargeting manually, non-selectable targets are dimmed to improve clarity.  [/p][p][/p][h3]- Event participation announcement [/h3][p]We will be participating in the indie game web-only event "EARLY TAKES" on October 4. [url="https://event.toranoana.jp/web-only/312253/"]https://event.toranoana.jp/web-only/312253/[/url][/p][p]We are preparing to make the exhibition demo playable online as well. Participation is free, so please feel free to drop by!   [/p][p][/p][p]Please look forward to it.   [/p][p]We are continuing to work diligently on development, so if you haven't already, please add "Erase" to your wishlist and support us! [/p][p][/p]

notes.title: [Erase News Letter vol.13]　Status Update and Release of Development Screenshots
notes.content: [p]Hello Players,[/p][p]Today we participated in the indie game exhibition "Game Pavilion JP" held in Osaka, and visitors played the demo at our booth.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658881/f46796a7265abeef6be4b0fabe7ccff6946f2fb0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Thank you to everyone who stopped by despite the rain and for your valuable feedback. [/p][p]We will use the feedback we received to further refine the game. We will continue to improve, and we would be grateful for your continued support.[/p][p][/p][p]We are also sharing a preview of some screens currently under development:[/p][p][/p][p]- Begun English localization[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658881/f854ea22605a6c7abe57d8836bb1c984d148e8eb.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658881/f5787e625e39ce1e5400c7149289147147befb6d.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658881/df652b768394b5061845be894789a667526a8222.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658881/3f5c9fa834f7a8cfc9c97ecaa3e73115fb12848a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]- Implemented a command to change characters' expressions during dialogue[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658881/7fbe45b455ff951cb4afa3c45bf05652c00e430b.gif"][/img][/p][p]- Battle finish cinematics[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658881/feeb192a5aa8bf0052afd89b99576033c3c0e4e0.png"][/img][/p][p]- Card pack opening animation[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658881/ffce97176789f0ef9a41e6bf3fdb0a9dffb2c8e6.png"][/img][/p][p]Our next exhibition appearance is scheduled for this autumn. [/p][p]By then, we plan to deliver a version that is easier to play and features more polished presentation. [/p][p][/p][p]Please look forward to it. [/p][p]We are continuing to work diligently on development, so if you haven't already, please add "Erase" to your wishlist and support us![/p]
